title: fastGRO Protocol for Nuclear Run-On Assay
author: Elisa Barbieri
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbmgik3w
materials: Determine concentration by Nanodrop or Qubit.
Use buffers provided with the RNA Clean and Purification kit-5 (Zymo Research). Add ethanol to wash and pre-wash buffers and resuspend DNAse in water.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclear Run-On (NRO) Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh 2x NRO buffer (100 µL/sample) containing: 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 5 mM MgCl2, 300 mM KCl, 1 mM DTT, 500 μM ATP, 500 μM GTP, 500 μM 4-thio-UTP, 2 μM CTP, 200 μ/ml Superase-in, and 1% Sarkosyl (N-Laurylsarcosine sodium salt solution).

steps.title: Isolate and Prepare Nuclei
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and wash in cold 1X PBS. Use 1.5-2 x10^7 nuclei per library.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 10 mL of ice-cold SB, incubate for 00:05:00, and spin at 400 x g for 10 minutes.
Remove supernatant and resuspend in 10 mL of FB; take 10 µL for cell count.
Centrifuge at 900 x g for 6 minutes and resuspend using wide-end pipette tips in FB to a concentration of 2x10^7 nuclei per 10 μl of FB.
Alternatively, flick to loosen pellet and resuspend in 25 mL of LyB, then centrifuge at 600 x g for 5 minutes.
Incubate on ice for 00:05:00, add 25 mL of LyB, and centrifuge at 600 x g for 5 minutes.
Vortex lightly while adding 10 mL of LyB.
Remove supernatant and resuspend in 10 mL GSB (volume of GSB must be at least 5 times the volume of cell pellet).

steps.title: Perform Nuclear Run-On Assay
steps.instruction: Perform the run-on reaction using prepared nuclei and NRO buffer.

substeps.instruction: Thaw nuclei on ice. (Optional: add 5-10% drosophila nuclei as spike-in).
Mix 100 µL of thawed nuclei solution with 100 µL of 2xNRO buffer; pipette up and down 15 times using end-cut pipette tips.
Incubate at 30 °C for 00:07:00.
Add 600 µL Trizol LS, vortex, and incubate at Room temperature for 00:05:00.
STOP POINT: Freeze with liquid nitrogen and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Extract and Purify RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA from the run-on reaction using chloroform and isopropanol precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Add 160 µL of chloroform, shake vigorously by hand for 00:00:15, and incubate at Room temperature for 00:02:00.
Centrifuge at 12000 rpm, 4 °C, for 15 minutes.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase into a new 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 400 µL of isopropanol (and optionally 1-2 ul of 2 μg/μL glycogen) to precipitate RNA; incubate at Room temperature for 00:10:00.
Centrifuge at 12000 rpm, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.
Wash RNA pellet with 1 mL of cold 75% ethanol and centrifuge at 12000 rpm, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.
Completely remove ethanol, air-dry pellet, and dissolve in 100 µL of nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Fragment RNA
steps.instruction: Fragment the extracted RNA using a Bioruptor.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 150 µg of RNA to a 1.5 ml tube and add water up to 500 µL. Save 5 μl of unfragmented RNA for TapeStation control.
Fragment RNA using Bioruptor settings: 1 cycle, 30 sec ON / 30 sec OFF at high settings.
Transfer fragmented RNA to a 2 ml tube.
Analyze fragmentation efficiency on Agilent 2200 TapeStation.
Sonicated RNA can be snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at -80 °C.

steps.title: Biotinylate RNA
steps.instruction: Biotinylate the fragmented RNA using EZ-link HPDP Biotin.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 150 µg of fragmented RNA into one 2 ml polypropylene Eppendorf tube.
Prepare Biotin-RNA mix in a 2 ml tube in this order: up to 150 μg fragmented RNA in 500 µL, 100 µL Biotinylation Buffer, 200 µL DMF, and 200 µL EZ-link HPDP Biotin.
Add 5-10% of labelled spike-in RNA if not using drosophila nuclei.
Incubate RNA at 65 °C for 00:10:00, then on ice for 00:05:00.
Add appr. 800 µL of chloroform to the RNA-biotin in a 2 mL phase-lock tube and mix by manually shaking.
Centrifuge at 4 °C and 16000 x g for 00:05:00 and transfer the upper phase (appr 1 mL) into a new tube.

steps.title: Capture 4-thio-labeled RNA
steps.instruction: Use streptavidin beads to capture biotinylated RNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare M280 Streptavidin Dynabeads: Take 100 µL beads per sample, wash twice with 2 volumes (200 µL) of wash buffer, and resuspend in 1 volume (100 µL) of wash buffer.
Increase the volume of RNA-biotin solution to 200 µL with nuclease-free water (or scale to 100 μL/50uL beads if <150 μg RNA).
Add 100 µL of prepared streptavidin beads to 200 µL of RNA-biotin.
Incubate at 4 °C for 00:15:00 with rotation.
Incubate in the dark at 24 °C and 800 rpm for 02:00:00.
Transfer tubes to the magnetic rack and collect the 4-thio-labeled RNA in a new tube.

steps.title: Wash and Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Wash the beads and elute the captured RNA.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 100 µL of 100 mM DTT and incubate for 00:05:00.
Wash at least 3 times with 900 µL of room temperature Wash Buffer (WB: 100 mM Tris pH 7.5, 10 mM EDTA pH 8.0, 1M NaCl, 0.1% Tween-20).
Wash at least 3 times with 900 µL of warm (65 °C) WB.
Transfer tubes to a magnetic rack and remove supernatant without disturbing beads.
Incubate at 65 °C for 00:10:00, then place on ice for 00:05:00.
Spin quickly at 4 °C and remove remaining supernatant with 200 μl and 10 μl pipettes (do NOT dry).
Resuspend RNA in 100 µL of nuclease-free water. Biotinylated RNA can be stored at -80 °C.

steps.title: Final RNA Purification and DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA using Zymo-Spin columns and perform DNase digestion.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL of RNA Binding Buffer to each sample and mix.
Add 600 µL of ethanol (95-100%) and mix.
Transfer sample to Zymo-Spin IC Column and centrifuge for 00:00:30; discard flow-through.
Wash with 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer (centrifuge 16000 x g, 30 seconds), then 700 µL RNA Wash Buffer (centrifuge 30 seconds). Discard flow-throughs.
Add 400 µL RNA Prep Buffer, centrifuge for 00:00:30, and discard flow-through.
Prepare DNase I reaction mix (5 µL DNase I, 35 µL DNA Digestion Buffer) and add 40 µL directly to the column matrix; incubate at Room temperature for 00:15:00.
Add 6 µL DNase/RNase-Free Water to the column matrix, incubate for 00:01:00, and centrifuge for 00:00:30.
Centrifuge for 00:01:00 at full speed and transfer the column to an RNase-free tube.
Add 1 volume (1 ml) of isopropanol, mix for 00:00:15, and add 1/10 volume (100 μl) of 5 M NaCl (plus optional glycogen).
Centrifuge at 10006 x g, 4 °C, for 30 minutes; remove supernatant.
Wash pellet with 1 mL of ice-cold 75% ethanol and centrifuge at 16000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant and measure concentration of labelled RNA by Qubit fluorometer.
Prepare libraries using NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep or other kits.
